cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can stop calling my win a gift. I used the same finishing technique as you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You copied me slowing down. I'd pulled my calf; the others stopped to help me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, controlled pace. I still crossed the line first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I waved you back to help, and you waved at the spectators.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Call it a disciplined finish, then. I kept racing all the way to the line.

reason: Rebuild the same-holder combination around an actual misread confident behavior and a concrete Drive request. Give B's correction or offer control over the next tactic.
